english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle to be used with insecure load at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport where the load carried by the vehicle was not at all times so secured and in such a position, namely **(..SPECIFY WHY THE LOAD WAS INSECURE..), that neither danger nor nuisance was caused or was likely to be caused to any person or property by reason of the load or any part thereof falling or being blown from the vehicle, or by reason of any other movement in relation to the vehicle of the load or any part thereof
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(8)(b) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
